description: This file contains Sass/SCSS utility functions, mixins, and variables used within a Bootstrap-based styling framework. It includes functions for map manipulations, color calculations, contrast assessments, and other style-related utilities, primarily serving as internal helper methods for styling purposes.
external_files: none (all functions are self-contained or related to Bootstrap/scss styling)
external_methods: get-function (used within map-loop for dynamic function call)

methods.name: _assert-ascending
methods.description: Ensures that a Sass map (e.g., grid breakpoints) is in ascending order, issuing warnings if not.

methods.name: _assert-starts-at-zero
methods.description: Checks if the first value in a map starts at zero, warning if it does not.

methods.name: to-rgb
methods.description: Converts a color value to its RGB components.

methods.name: rgba-css-var
methods.description: Generates an RGBA CSS variable string based on identifiers, used for theming.

methods.name: map-loop
methods.description: Iterates over a Sass map, applying a specified function to each key-value pair.

methods.name: varify
methods.description: Creates a list of CSS variables with a common prefix.

methods.name: negativify-map
methods.description: Generates a map of the negatives of the values in a given map, prefixing keys with 'n'.

methods.name: map-get-multiple
methods.description: Fetches multiple keys from a Sass map based on a list of desired keys.

methods.name: map-merge-multiple
methods.description: Combines multiple maps into one.

methods.name: str-replace
methods.description: Performs string replacement within a string, used for manipulating SVG or CSS strings.

methods.name: escape-svg
methods.description: Escapes characters in an SVG data URI string to ensure proper embedding.

methods.name: color-contrast
methods.description: Chooses an appropriate foreground color based on background contrast, aiming for accessibility.

methods.name: contrast-ratio
methods.description: Calculates the contrast ratio between two colors based on luminance.

methods.name: luminance
methods.description: Calculates the luminance of a color for contrast evaluation.

methods.name: opaque
methods.description: Generates an opaque color by mixing a foreground with a background.

methods.name: tint-color
methods.description: Blends a color with white to lighten it.

methods.name: shade-color
methods.description: Blends a color with black to darken it.

methods.name: shift-color
methods.description: Shades or tints a color depending on the weight parameter.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two values, supporting calculations with units.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts one value from another, with unit support.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Divides two numbers with optional precision handling, supporting units.
